data.one_liner: Create thumbnail images from local video files or URLs as bytes or files.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that generates thumbnail images from local video files or remote URLs. It can return the thumbnail as in-memory bytes or save it to a temporary directory, supporting multiple file processing at once.
use_when: You need to generate video previews or thumbnails locally on device or web.
You want to extract thumbnails as in-memory bytes or XFiles.
avoid_when: You need video playback features rather than just frame extraction.
You are targeting Windows N/KN editions without the Media Feature Pack.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Can output either in-memory bytes or XFiles.
Supports batch processing of multiple videos.
weaknesses: Linux requires FFmpeg and libwebp development packages at build time.
Windows has limitations with WebP format and authentication headers.
data.setup_notes: Linux requires build-time development packages for FFmpeg and libwebp. Windows requires the Media Feature Pack on N/KN editions.
